app.privacy: Your data never leaves your device.
app.privacyDetail: Everything runs in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, stored on a server, or tracked.
app.footer: Open source under the MIT licence.
app.howItWorks: Scan with any phone camera to get an “Add to Contacts” prompt with everything filled in.

vcard.label: Contact card
vcard.description: Saves your details straight into the phonebook.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Opens a WhatsApp chat with you.

wifi.label: Wi-Fi
wifi.description: Joins a Wi-Fi network without typing the password.

whatsappSameAsMobile.label: WhatsApp is the same as my mobile number
whatsappSameAsMobile.description: Uses the first mobile number above.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp number
whatsapp.description: Local numbers are assumed to be in Bangladesh (+880).

note.label: Note
note.description: Long notes make the QR code denser and harder to scan.

message.label: Pre-filled message
message.placeholder: Hi! I got your number from your card.

errors.invalidPhone: Enter a valid phone number, e.g. 01712-345678 or +8801712345678.
errors.invalidUrl: Enter a valid web address, e.g. example.com.

presets.heading: Presets
presets.saveLabel: Save current design as a preset

colors.heading: Colours
colors.transparentHint: PNG, SVG and WebP only. JPEG always uses the background colour.

ecc.label: Error correction
ecc.forced: Set to High while a logo is used.

logo.label: Logo
logo.hint: The image is read on your device and never uploaded.
logo.tooLarge: That image is too large (max 5 MB).

density.label: Scan density
density.ok: OK — scan at a reasonable size
density.risky: Risky — may be hard to scan
density.tooLong: Too much data for a QR code
density.hintRisky: Remove the note or logo, or shorten some fields, to improve scanning.
density.hintTooLong: Remove some details — this cannot fit in a QR code.
density.lowContrast: Low contrast between foreground and background — the code may not scan.
density.inverted: Light dots on a dark background don’t scan on some phones.

export.heading: Download
export.copyFailed: Could not copy the image. Try downloading it instead.

share.linkCopied: Link copied. Anyone with it can edit a copy of this QR.
share.linkNote: The link stores your details in the part after “#”, which is never sent to the server. Logos are not included.
share.resetDescription: This clears all details and the design on this device. Saved presets are kept.

preview.empty: Fill in the form to generate your QR code.
preview.error: The preview could not be drawn.
